subject.title: refactor(apns): move registrations to shared SQLite

question: Is it acceptable for existing APNs delivery to remain unavailable until the operator explicitly runs `openclaw doctor --fix`, or must the upgrade provide a stronger visible recovery gate before the SQLite-only runtime takes effect?
rationale: This is a deliberate stored-state compatibility boundary affecting shipped iOS push registrations, and automated review cannot choose the acceptable operator-impact contract.

options.title: Require proven recovery gate
options.body: Keep the SQLite-only design but require live upgrade proof and a clearly visible Doctor recovery path before merge.

options.title: Accept explicit Doctor step
options.body: Accept temporary APNs unavailability as a documented upgrade requirement based on the existing automated migration coverage.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Defer landing until the upgrade can avoid an easily missed operator action without adding runtime fallback or dual authority.

recommendation.title: Require proven recovery gate
recommendation.body: Keep the SQLite-only design but require live upgrade proof and a clearly visible Doctor recovery path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the proposed APNs migration design and is best positioned to decide the intended upgrade contract.
